title: Simple portal frame analysis
description_for_llm: Linear elastic (Theory I) analysis of a portal style frame of columns and beams with moment carrying joints. Use for one or few storey rigid frames built from straight line members. Assumptions: member axes are straight curves in metres, supports per the template (fixed bases), rigid beam to column connections, one steel section for all members, vertical line load on the beams (ALMOND_IN_LOAD_KN drives the template's Unit-Z load vector; the template's built-in lateral line load of -2 kN/m in X remains active), plus self weight. Limits: no second order (P-Delta) effects, so slender sway frames are underchecked; no per-element utilization output, so the validator's strength check falls back to deflection and the L/250 limit; no connection design. HARNESSED 2026-08-29: ALMOND_IN_LINES replaces the template's internal parametric geometry at the Create Linear Element input; outputs read Analyse max displacement (cm) and Assemble mass (kg).

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_LINES
inputs.description: Frame member axis curves (columns and beams), node-merged at joints.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_LOAD_KN
inputs.description: Vertical line-load magnitude in kN/m applied to the frame beams per the template layout (Unit-Z vector).

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_SUPPORTS
inputs.description: Support node positions (column bases). When omitted, the validator supplies the lowest-Z nodes of the input members automatically, mirroring the api pathway's convention.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_DISP_MM
outputs.description: Largest nodal displacement; Karamba's Analyse emits centimetres, converted downstream per these units.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_MASS_KG
outputs.description: Total structural mass of the model.
